Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Rafael and I put together a short 30-minute demo we think will map to the three use cases you called out (real-time triage summaries, embedding-driven search, and retention-aware caching).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 24, 14:00–14:30
- Mon Nov 29, 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, happy to propose the first two weeks of December. I attached a one-page mutual action plan draft to make the next steps explicit.

Would you like Rafael (solutions engineering) to focus on the technical demo or would you prefer a joint session with Marcus from pricing to discuss cost/commit options?

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the options. Two quick notes from my side: finance has put a temporary hold on new vendor demos tied to spend (capex/contract approvals) while we complete FY planning and a headcount reshuffle. Our procurement lead (CC'd) is consolidating vendor meetings and we expect a gating decision after our December 9 planning offsite.

Also, key stakeholders (product and infra) are traveling the week of Nov 29 — that would make the Nov 29 slot risky.

Can we pause scheduling until after Dec 9? If helpful, you can send a short (15–20 slide) capabilities deck and the mutual action plan; procurement will review and queue us for the Jan prioritization wave.

Elena Ramos
VP Product | Stellar Medical Systems
elena.r@stellarms.com

On a related note, procurement asked us to consolidate all vendor SSO/KMS and SOC2 evidence up front — they flagged that as a must-have for any vendor discussion post-planning.

Thanks for the heads-up, Elena — totally understood.

A couple quick proposals to keep momentum while respecting your procurement window:
1) We’ll hold off on live scheduling until you’re out of planning (post-Dec 9).
2) Rafael offered to run a brief"pre-demo" advisory call (15–20 min) with product/infra in early January to align on success criteria — no live model invocations, just architecture and integration discussion.
3) I’m attaching the MA plan and an SOC2 + security summary we typically provide to procurement so you can share internally.

Tentative January slots (PT):
- Mon Jan 10, 10:00–10:30
- Tue Jan 11, 15:00–15:30

If procurement prefers, we can also stand down entirely and pick back up when you give the green light.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the update and for looping procurement in. We’ll pause active scheduling until you give the go-ahead after the Dec 9 planning offsite.

To make the January cadence painless, I’ve dropped a tentative calendar hold for Mon Jan 10, 10:00–10:30 PT (invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=jan10-demo). No action required on your side — we’ll remove the hold if your team asks us to.

Next steps (for our side):
- Rafael will send the concise security packet + the MA plan (finalized) to procurement this week.
- Marcus will prepare a short pricing scenarios table tied to committed throughput so procurement has numbers for planning.
- I’ll update HubSpot with the procurement contact and the note that timing is driven by FY planning.

If anything changes between now and Dec 9, please let us know and we’ll adapt. Appreciate your transparency — we want to make the restart as low-friction as possible.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
